title: Scenario card
description: One practice scenario. 'ground_truth' and 'reveal' are hidden from the trainee until the debrief.

traveling_with.description: Who is present at the encounter, e.g. 'her father', 'an older acquaintance'

backstory.description: What is actually going on, written for the role-play model. Synthetic only.

role_play_instructions.description: How the traveler behaves: what they volunteer, what they deflect, how they respond to open vs. accusatory questions.

voice_direction.description: Acting instruction for the voice model.

indicators_present.description: Empty array for most innocent scenarios (an innocent scenario MAY still contain a benign-explanation indicator).

summary.description: Shown to trainee in debrief: what was actually going on.
